factors.name: donor
factors.levels: 7 skaters (d1..d7), each sampled before and after

final.matrix_scale: RSEM gene-level expected counts (S2.4.p1), rounded with round(x, 0) before DESeq2 (author script line 66)
final.normalization: DESeq2 size factors; rlog + ComBat only for PCA/plots (S2.5.p1)
final.paper_formula: ~ donor + exercise, contrast exercise after vs before (FIG1; author script lines 66-69)
final.gene_filter: none before DESeq2 (author script line 66 uses the full table; DESeq2 independent filtering at default alpha 0.1)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S2.5.p1; FIG1 legend ('reported at 10% FDR'); author script all_analysis_and_figures.R:83-84 (padj <= 0.1)

final.enrichment_in_paper: ORA (clusterProfiler) with MSigDB H and CP collections, plus fGSEA (S2.5.p1, S3.3.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.3.p1 and S10.p1 name GSE164890 as the paper's deposit (14 samples, 7 skaters before/after). S2.5.p1 and FIG1 give DESeq2 with a 'donor + exercise' design and 10% FDR; S3.2.p2 gives 2516 up / 1542 down. The authors' script, cited by the paper, confirms round(counts,0), no prefilter, relevel to 'before', results() with default alpha and padj <= 0.1.

checks.author_repo_counts_file: data/rsem.genes.counts.tsv.gz in the authors' repo has the same name stem; column names 1after..7before match Conditions.txt

ownership.reasoning: GSE164890 is cited as the paper's deposit; 14 GSMs = 7 skaters x 2 time points, as in S2.3.p1. Matrix columns (1after..7before) equal the GEO description field and the authors' Conditions.txt sample names.

alignment.reasoning: Exact match of matrix columns to GEO 'description'. subject = skater number (d1..d7, as in the authors' Conditions.txt); time pre/post from the time point characteristic.

matrix.reasoning: Values are non-negative, mostly integer-valued but with fractional RSEM expected counts in ~5.9k genes; library sums 9.7-35 M match the reported 12-41 M reads with 68-83% assigned. These are estimated counts, not TPM (the TPM table is a separate file). The authors' published script rounds them to integers before DESeq2, which documents the rounding recipe.

final.estimand_type: within-subject effect of the exercise bout
final.suitability_matrix_type_note: suitability run with 'raw counts' route family; the matrix is RSEM estimated counts rounded per the authors' recipe (matrix gate)

design.reasoning: Seven skaters each sampled before and after the bout. The paper's estimand is the after-vs-before change with donor in the model (FIG1, S3.2.p1). Suitability: analyzable, one comparison time_post_vs_pre with 7 per arm; metadata sex (female, paper) agrees with X/Y expression for all 14 samples.

candidates.reason_rejected: ignores the 7 skaters sampled twice; the paper uses 'donor + exercise' (FIG1) and notes a strong donor effect (S3.2.p1)
the paper uses ComBat only for PCA/plots (S2.5.p1); testing ComBat output inflates significance

design.subject: subject

covariance.reasoning: All 7 subjects have exactly one pre and one post sample. subject is crossed with time; ~ subject + time is full rank with residual df = 14 - 8 = 6. No batch or other covariate is recorded; sex is constant.

final.transform: round(x, 0), half to even, as in the authors' script (line 66); no gene prefilter beyond dropping all-zero genes

paper_route.method: DESeq2 ~ donor + exercise on round(RSEM counts)

method.reasoning: Paper and authors' script use DESeq2 on rounded RSEM gene counts with donor + exercise. The executor's alpha is set to the paper's FDR 0.1 so independent filtering matches R's results() default.

threshold.reasoning: Paper: genes retained at FDR < 0.1 (S2.5.p1), 'reported at 10% FDR' (FIG1); the script counts padj <= 0.1 with no fold-change cutoff. Applied exactly.

final.note: DESeq2 ~ subject + time on round(RSEM counts) at padj <= 0.1 as in the paper and the authors' script; pydeseq2 instead of R DESeq2 1.18.1

study.reasoning: All gates valid; the paper route ran unchanged (7 per arm, residual df 6, so no exploratory label).

executions.name: time_post_vs_pre
executions.reasoning: DESeq2 ~ subject + time on rounded RSEM counts (author script)

enrichment.reasoning: paper ran GSEA on the DESeq2 ranking
